content: निवर्तन {%a.%} .²1 Causing to return. .²2 Turning back, ceasing. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Returning, turning or coming back, return; इह हि पततां नास्त्यालम्बो न चापि निवर्तनम् <ls>Śānti. 3. 2</ls>. .²2 Not happening, ceasing. .²3 Desisting or abstaining from (with <ab>abl.</ab>) .²4 Desisting from work, inactivity (<ab>opp.</ab> प्रवर्तन); <ls>Kām. 1. 28</ls>. .²5 Bringing back; <ls>Amaru. 84</ls>. .²6 Repenting, a desire to improve. .²7 A measure of land (20 rods). .²8 Averting, keeping back from (with <ab>abl.</ab>) विनिपातनिवर्तनक्षमम् <ls>Ki. 2. 13</ls>.
